blocks.purpose: Skip attack and transfer immediately.
blocks.entry: Exactly one process; private pointers and counters; pristine image.
blocks.processEffect: One process throughout; SPL is written as a bomb, never executed locally.
blocks.cost: Measured after assembly, including data and linking instructions.
blocks.searchLimits: Current shared search: STEP 1..2048, HOP 256..7000, WAIT 1..768, STUN 1..4096. This deliberately bounded first grammar does not cover every landing site in 94x.
blocks.limitations: Solo behavior does not guarantee safety after enemy writes. No arbitrary block ordering or shared-state concurrency.
